question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Bite someone’s head off

options.text: Ask someone the same question again and again
Go on repeating the same point

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Speak angrily without any reason'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate answer for the idiom** 'Bite someone's head off'** is** 'Speak angrily without any reason'.**
 
• **Bite someone's head off:** to speak to someone angrily when there is no reason to. (किसी से गुस्से में बात करना जब कोई कारण न हो)
 
 
• *Example: I just asked if I could help – you don't have to **bite my head off!***

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Speak angrily without any reason.*
